questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with TDG and/or PMA.
For each of the C&M services your organisation procures in Australia, please provide details of your current provider(s), the services they provide, and an overview of your procurement processes.

How closely do TDG and PMA compete for the supply of C&M services (for any particular C&M services, customer types or geographic locations)? Where TDG and PMA compete closely, identify alternative suppliers capable of supplying the relevant services (noting any differences in price, service, technical expertise or geographic presence).
Do you have any competition concerns about the removal of PMA as a competitor in relation to the supply of C&M services, including any specific type of service?

Identify and describe the types of C&M services you supply and in which geographic areas you supply these, including whether you compete for specific types of C&M services or customer types (e.g. large industrial customers, or small/local customers), or customers in a particular industry?
Identify who you consider to be your competitors for each of the C&M services you supply.
Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC’s consideration of the Acquisition.
